originality.rationale: Johnson (arXiv:2007.03569) proves information-theoretic convergence and names optimal-rate questions; Gasull et al. (TEST 2015) have the Gamma max and norming constants but compare CDFs; prior KL optimum for exponential maxima is excluded (alpha=1). No published source inspected implies this positive universal fitted-KL coefficient for fixed nonexponential Gamma shapes. Historical priority is qualified.

value.rationale: Exact sharp residual information after optimizing both Gumbel location and scale for every fixed nonexponential Gamma shape is a natural refinement of published entropy convergence; it provides the nontrivial universal zeta(3) constant and a unique calibration, distinct from the faster exponential endpoint. Relevant for chi-square/Gamma maximum false-alarm calibration.
